notes.title: Santa's Slippery Slope has gone GOLD!
notes.notes:
Santa's Slippery Slope has gone gold and is on track for its Dec. 17th release! See you all there, and HAPPY HOLIDAYS!

Feel free to contact me at support@hondune.com or on twitter @hondune. 

Remember to share this game around as much as you can, it really helps out us little indies!
